header.name: §bAegis Primordial§r — Null Veil Sentinel (Behavior)
header.description:
§7AEGIS-PRIMORDIAL: NULL VEIL SENTINEL§r
§bA human-form guardian engineered to hunt and erase invulnerable Locust anomalies.§r

§a◆ Null Sever protocol§r — Script-API force-removal that bypasses damage_sensor, min_health and /kill immunity.
§a◆ Tracking Sense§r — detects Locust signatures through walls.
§a◆ Guardian Aura§r — Regeneration + Resistance to nearby players.
§a◆ Overdrive§r — engages automatically when an anomaly is close.

§cRequires the companion resource pack.§r
